content.user_title: Generate Excel Formulas From Plain Language
content.value_statement: Spreadsheet work slows down when formulas, macros, and PivotTables are hard to design. This skill turns plain-language Excel needs into formulas, VBA macro plans, and PivotTable guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users.
actual_capabilities: Generates Excel formula suggestions from described spreadsheet needs.
Provides VBA macro approaches for office automation tasks.
Suggests PivotTable plans for summarizing spreadsheet data.
Accepts natural language instructions during a chat workflow.
Reminds users to review important AI-generated outputs manually.
limitations: The skill provides guidance; it does not directly inspect workbook files unless the user supplies data context.
Generated formulas and macros need manual testing before use in important spreadsheets.
The source file does not define workbook-specific templates or sample datasets.
Complex Excel version differences may require user adjustment.

use_cases.title: Build formulas faster
use_cases.description: Convert business rules into Excel formula suggestions with short explanations and test checks.

use_cases.title: Automate recurring worksheets
use_cases.description: Plan VBA macro steps for cleanup, formatting, and repeated workbook tasks.

use_cases.title: Plan spreadsheet reports
use_cases.description: Choose PivotTable rows, columns, values, and filters for recurring data summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic formula
prompt_templates.prompt: I have columns for dates, sales, and region. Create an Excel formula that totals sales for one region in one month.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot an existing formula
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Excel formula and explain why it returns an error: [paste formula]. Suggest a corrected version and testing steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a PivotTable plan
prompt_templates.prompt: I have sales rows with date, customer, product, region, quantity, and revenue. Recommend a PivotTable layout for monthly revenue and top products.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a VBA automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a VBA macro approach that imports a monthly sheet, cleans blank rows, refreshes PivotTables, and logs errors. Include safety checks before running.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly sales total by region.
output_examples.output: Returns a criteria-based formula approach, explains the date and region conditions, and lists checks for source data formatting.

output_examples.input: Summarize revenue by product and month.
output_examples.output: Recommends a PivotTable layout with months as columns, products as rows, revenue as values, and region as a filter.

output_examples.input: Automate cleanup for a weekly report.
output_examples.output: Outlines VBA macro steps for backup, blank-row removal, format normalization, PivotTable refresh, and manual review before use.

best_practices: Provide column names, sample rows, expected result, and Excel version when asking for formulas.
Test generated formulas and macros on a copy of the workbook before production use.
Ask for a short explanation so teammates can maintain the spreadsheet later.
anti_patterns: Do not paste confidential workbook data unless it is required and allowed.
Do not run generated VBA macros without reading and testing them first.
Do not request one formula without explaining edge cases, blanks, and error rules.

faq.question: Can this skill write Excel formulas?
faq.answer: Yes. It converts spreadsheet requirements into formula suggestions and explanations.

faq.question: Can it help with VBA macros?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline VBA macros and safety checks, but users should test every macro.

faq.question: Does it create PivotTable plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest row, column, value, and filter layouts for PivotTable reports.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it edit workbook files directly?
faq.answer: No. The skill file describes chat-based guidance, not direct workbook editing.

faq.question: Is this safe for important spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Use it as AI assistance. Review critical outputs and test formulas or macros before relying on them.
